{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data with revenue parsed
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute overall conversion rate by channel
overall_conversion = sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean().reset_index()

# Compute total revenue by channel
total_revenue_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum().reset_index()

# Print the values that will be used in evidence
print('Overall conversion rate by channel:')
print(overall_conversion)

print('\nTotal revenue by channel:')
print(total_revenue_by_channel)"}
